reviews.comment: He wasn't my best professor, but some reviews are exaggerated. Lectures were a little hard to follow. End of week quizzes were a little too hard for the time allotted. Tests were tough, but I studied a bit before each one and I ended up fine. He graded pretty soft on the final from what I could tell. Not the end of the world if you get him.

His lectures didn't do the best job at breaking down things well but they were almost always structured with a preplanned flow and slides he would post on canvas. He told us throughout the year that he can't do curves on tests but he did try and be a little lenient when grading tests, especially the final. The weekly quizzes were also very hard.

Your grade is very test-dependent. He's mentioned during a test that he's purposefully making you think beyond what you've learned, which is amazing IF you are a passionate mathematician. Grade-dependent tests are not the place to challenge students like this. If you're not a diehard math-lover, those tests are gonna be hard, so study intensely.

He has a strong Italian accent and weird word choice, which makes the trippy concepts of the class even harder to understand. He consistently had test averages lower than those of other sections, and his exams had questions that were not like the homework at all. I wish I could have given him a pizza with ketchup because he deserved it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really smart guy, but sometimes his explanations went over your head which it more difficult than it needed to be. Even studying a significant amount for exams, it was hard to get As. Weekly quizzes that weren't too bad and homework on each lesson. Overall, a decent prof, but you generally need to teach yourself to fully understand the material.
